purpose: Authenticate listed author host assets and inventory existing sequences/headers; no inferred stock aliases, phenotype assignment, model fit or sequence design

parse_rules.nucleotide_files: Strict FASTA preserving records; existing DNA/IUPAC alphabet only, no concatenation or edits
parse_rules.aaseq: If FASTA, inventory deposited proteins with alphabet counts and hashes; otherwise mark format unresolved
parse_rules.genes_tab: Header and data-row count only; no biological or susceptibility labels inferred

comparison: Exact single-record normalized sequence hash versus original public-reference manifest only; mismatch or multirecord never repaired
timing: Written before payload retrieval or sequence comparison; source tree and two browser configurations already inspected
